anxiety: It's completely normal to feel anxious. Can you try taking a slow, deep breath with me?
Anxiety can be really overwhelming. What's one small thing you can do right now to feel safe?
depression: I'm sorry you're feeling so down. You don't have to carry this alone.
Depression can make everything feel heavy. Be gentle with yourself today.
stress: It sounds like you have a lot on your plate. Is there anything you can set aside for tomorrow?
When we're stressed, our bodies need rest. Have you taken a break recently?
sleep issues: Lack of sleep makes everything harder. Maybe a warm drink or dimming the lights could help wind down.
It's frustrating when you can't sleep. Try not to force it; just rest your body.
grief: I am so sorry for your loss. There is no timeline for grief.
Grief is a process that takes time. It's okay to feel whatever you're feeling right now.
